human_actions_pending.context: Path A was selected 2026-05-15 but 85-04 has not been planned/executed yet. The recent session focused on tangential e2e stabilization (CLEAN-02, ToU 406 chase, variant-constituency rewrite) rather than 85-04 itself.

decisions.decision: ToU 406 refreshSession() mitigation documented in _setPassword as future-reference but NOT implemented
decisions.rationale: 20×repeat-each loop did not reproduce the 406 after (a) adding visible error UI to the ToU layout, (b) adding expect.toPass click retry, (c) adding per-iteration clearMailboxForRecipient + unregisterCandidate beforeEach. Extra refreshSession() round-trip on every password set/reset could turn a working flow into a thrown error in edge cases (expired refresh token, network partition).

decisions.decision: variant-constituency template rewritten to disjoint-group shape (E1→east municipalities, E2→west municipalities)
decisions.rationale: Original hierarchy-conflated shape tripped Election.getApplicableConstituency multi-match throw. Disjoint groups also enable per-election filtering assertions.

decisions.decision: (voters)/(located)/+layout.ts uses withNext(base) helper for ? vs & separator
decisions.rationale: Constituencies redirect concatenated `?next=…` against a base already carrying `?electionId=…`, producing a malformed URL that SvelteKit 500'd on. Elections branch was latently affected too even though buildRoute({Elections}) returns no query string today.

decisions.decision: EntityListWithControls data-testid forwarded to inner EntityList cards container
decisions.rationale: Previously landed on the filter-chrome wrapper, so chained `.getByText()` assertions on `voter-results-list` found nothing. All 18+ external consumers audited — visibility/timing unchanged.

decisions.decision: expect.toPass() retry pattern adopted at the candidate-profile ToU Continue click; pattern available for broader audit if needed
decisions.rationale: Canonical Playwright pattern for `click + observable consequence` retry. Idempotent — a successful click short-circuits on the next iteration's post-condition.

decisions.decision: clearMailboxForRecipient(email) added to emailHelper (per-recipient Mailpit delete-by-ids)
decisions.rationale: Mailpit's default search ceiling (50 results) intermittently masked new invite emails as missing under --repeat-each=20. Per-recipient (not global purge) is parallel-worker-safe.
